description: Client-side JavaScript for shopping cart functionality in ERPNext, including cart updates, dropdown handling, and cookie management.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters into an object.

methods.name: show_shoppingcart_dropdown
methods.description: Displays shopping cart dropdown menu when triggered.

methods.name: update_cart
methods.description: Updates shopping cart items; redirects to login if user is guest.

methods.name: set_cart_count
methods.description: Sets the shopping cart item count display and visibility.

methods.name: shopping_cart_update
methods.description: Updates cart item quantities and UI.

methods.name: bind_dropdown_cart_buttons
methods.description: Binds event handlers for cart quantity spinner buttons.

methods.name: show_cart_navbar
methods.description: Checks if shopping cart is enabled and toggles visibility.
